# `<e-tag>`

<p><img alt="e-tag screenshot" src="__tests__/__screenshots__/display-tag--closable.png" width="480" /></p>

Small inline label, optionally removable.

Children are used as the tag text. Distinct from `<e-badge>` (purely
decorative) because a tag can be dismissed by the user via a close button.

> Source: [tag.ts](./tag.ts)

## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `closable` | `boolean` | — | Renders a close button after the label. |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | — | Disables the close button. |

## Events

| Event | Detail | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `e-close` | `CustomEvent<{value: string}>` | Fired when the close button is activated. `value` is the tag's text content. |

## Slots

| Slot | Description |
| --- | --- |
| _(default)_ | Default slot for the tag label. |
